targets.rawSql: WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(pack.lv_batt_v) AS "pdu/lv_batt_v [V]", AVG(pack.lv_batt_c) AS "pdu/lv_batt_c [A]", AVG(pack.lv_batt_t) AS "pdu/lv_batt_t [C]" FROM pack JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = pack.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(pack.lv_boards_current) AS "vcu/lv_boards_current [A]", AVG(diagnostics_high.shutdown_current) AS "vcu/shutdown_current [A]", AVG(thermal.batt_cooling_current) AS "vcu/batt_cooling_current [A]", AVG(thermal.motor_cooling_current) AS "vcu/motor_cooling_current [A]", AVG(controls.lights_current) AS "vcu/lights_current [A]" FROM pack JOIN diagnostics_high ON diagnostics_high.packet_id = pack.packet_id JOIN thermal ON thermal.packet_id = pack.packet_id JOIN controls ON controls.packet_id = pack.packet_id JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = pack.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(thermal.ambient_temp) AS "pdu/ambient_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.discharge_r_temp) AS "pdu/discharge_r_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.batt_loop_batt_temp) AS "pdu/batt_loop_batt_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.batt_loop_rad_temp) AS "pdu/batt_loop_rad_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.inverter_temp) AS "pdu/inverter_temp [C]" FROM thermal JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = thermal.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(thermal.motor_loop_motor_temp) AS "tsm/motor_loop_motor_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.motor_loop_inverter_temp) AS "tsm/motor_loop_inverter_temp [C]", AVG(thermal.motor_loop_rad_temp) AS "tsm/motor_loop_rad_temp [C]" FROM thermal JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = thermal.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT * FROM get_partition_bounds('$Zoom', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) ) SELECT to_timestamp(floor(packet.time / bounds.bucket_len) * bounds.bucket_len / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(thermal.batt_loop_rad_fan_speed) AS "pdu/batt_loop_rad_fan_speed [RPM]", AVG(thermal.motor_loop_rad_fan_speed) AS "tsm/motor_loop_rad_fan_speed [RPM]" FROM thermal JOIN packet ON packet.packet_id = thermal.packet_id JOIN bounds ON true WHERE packet.time BETWEEN bounds.effective_start AND bounds.effective_end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time;
